column7:
Reduction in provision
of ₹100.00 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹600.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹600.00 lakh and
surrender of ₹100.00
lakh. Increase was
attributed to Land
acquisition. Reduction
in provision by re-
appropriation was
attributed to anticipated
saving. Reasons for
surrender as well as
final saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).
